name: How do plumbers detect underground water leaks?

mainEntity.name: How do plumbers detect underground water leaks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbers use specialized equipment to accurately detect underground water leaks without extensive digging. This often includes acoustic listening devices that amplify the sound of water escaping pipes, ground-penetrating radar (GPR) to map subsurface structures, and thermal imaging cameras to identify temperature changes caused by escaping water. In some cases, a tracer gas may be introduced into the pipe, and a detector is used to find where the gas escapes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers detect underground leaks using acoustic listening devices, ground-penetrating radar, thermal imaging, or tracer gas to locate the exact source.
